Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 40716 of 2024
Applicant :- Kamlesh Kumar Patel

Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Jagdeesh Narayan,Ram Asre
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.

Heard Sri Ram Asre, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Jhamman Ram, learned Aga-I for
the State.

2.  The instant bail application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Session Trial No.457 of 2021 (State vs. Kamlesh) arising out of Case Crime No.322 of 2020 under Sections 498A,
304B IPC and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station-Handia, District-Prayagraj during pendency of the trial.

3. FIR of the present case was lodged against the applicant and his two other family members on 3.6.2020 and according to the FIR, marriage of the applicant was solemnized with the sister of the informant about four years before and after marriage, due to want of dowry, applicant and his family members tortured her and on 2.6.2020, informant received an information that his sister has died.

sentences.text:
4. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that applicant is husband of the deceased and on the basis of false allegation of demand of dowry and torture, he has been made accused along with other family members.
5.

He further submits that actually even after four years of marriage, deceased could not be conceived and only due to this reason, she was under under deep depression and under depression,
she committed suicide by hanging herself.
It is further submitted that post mortem report of the deceased also suggests that deceased died due to hanging.
6. He further submits that applicant is not having any criminal history and in the present matter applicant is in jail since 27.10.2020.

7. Per contra, learned AGA opposed the prayer for bail and submits that applicant is husband of the deceased and his wife died within four years of her marriage under abnormal circumstances and there is also allegation of demand of dowry, but could not dispute the fact that prima faice it appears to be a case of suicidal death and applicant is in jail in the present matter for last more than four years.
8.
I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

9. However, applicant is husband of the deceased and his wife died within four years of her marriage in her matrimonial home under abnormal circumstances and there is also allegation of demand of dowry, but from the FIR it reflects that no specific demand of dowry could be disclosed and on the basis of vague allegation of demand of dowry, FIR of the present case was lodged.

10. Further, postmortem report suggests that deceased died due to hanging, therefore, prima faice it appears to be a case of suicidal death and, therefore, argument advanced by learned counsel for the applicant with regard to the alleged suicide committed by deceased cannot be ruled out at this stage.
11. Further, applicant is not having any criminal history and in the present matter, he is in jail since 27.10.2020, i.e., for the last more than four years.

12. Therefore, considering the facts and circumstances of the case discussed above, in my view,
applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
13. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

14. Let the applicant - Kamlesh Kumar Patel be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.

sentences.text: (ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
15. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.

16. It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the merits of the case during trial.
